plans.name: Bandit, Sindit (claws to Lv 30, then DEX daggers)
plans.summary: Lucky Seven on a claw for 1st job, then Savage Blow on DEX daggers from Lv 30. No SP reset: Lucky Seven stays and Double Stab is skipped.
plans.note: Why: Lucky Seven hits from range and goes by LUK, so Lv 10-30 needs no Double Stab, and Savage Blow needs no 1st-job skill. Trade-off: those 20 SP do nothing with a dagger in hand, though a claw still uses them. Sindit guides often reset SP near Lv 40 to move them; Leafline can't plan a reset. Claws ask for as much DEX as their level, more than DEX daggers do, and throwing stars cost mesos. Savage Blow 11 is where the data gives it a 5th hit, so it leads 2nd job here.

reading.name: NiaDB
reading.credit: NiaDB's Bandit guide by Nia Meow covers these paths in its own words and numbers. Leafline's plan was worked out from the skill and item data and doesn't follow it.

plans.name: Bandit, DEX daggers
plans.summary: Double Stab for 1st job, then Savage Blow and Steal. DEX only as far as the next DEX dagger needs, the rest into LUK.
plans.note: Why: thief armour asks for DEX as well (DEX 60 at Lv 70), so one stat covers both, and DEX adds Accuracy. Trade-off: the item data lists DEX daggers one attack-speed step slower than STR daggers of the same level, for 1 more attack. Savage Blow goes to 11 early, where the data gives it a 5th hit and it passes Double Stab 20, then to 21 for a 6th.

reading.name: NiaDB
reading.credit: NiaDB's Bandit guide by Nia Meow covers these paths in its own words and numbers. Leafline's plan was worked out from the skill and item data and doesn't follow it.

plans.name: Bandit, STR daggers (LUK main)
plans.summary: Double Stab for 1st job, then Savage Blow and Steal. STR only as far as the next STR dagger needs, the rest into LUK. Not a STR-main build: LUK stays the damage stat.
plans.note: Why: the item data lists STR daggers one attack-speed step faster. Trade-off: thief armour past Lv 15 asks for DEX this plan doesn't add (DEX 60 at Lv 70), so it plans Lv 15 thief pieces and all-class capes and earrings. Add DEX yourself to wear more. STR adds no Accuracy. The spare point of the roll goes into STR.
